subject: Exciting Summer Deals Inside!
body: Dear valued customer, We are thrilled to announce our exclusive summer promotion! Enjoy up to 50% off on selected items, including beachwear, sunglasses, and outdoor gear. Hurry, these offers won't last long! Best regards, The Summer Deals Team
